proof: Flip about the right edge reverses x and glyph order; the subsequent in-plane halfturn reverses x again and y once. Composition is(x,y)->(x,-y)+translation, so left-to-right slot order remains KANGAROO and every glyph vertically flips. All14 full contours including glass uniquely matchE (residual0; A-D differ). D has reversed glyph order although each K/N/G/O local contour is a vertical flip. The six partial outer edges leave black letters and white counters unchanged.
